runs.final_sql: SELECT c.clnt_id, a.accn_id FROM clnt c JOIN dsp d ON d.ref1 = c.clnt_id JOIN acct a ON a.accn_id = d.ref2 JOIN dstr ds ON ds.dstr_id = a.ref1 WHERE c.brth_dt >= '1983-01-01' AND c.brth_dt < '1988-01-01' AND ds.a3 = 'east Bohemia'
